title: Define hosted evidence fields
responsibility: Defines reusable validation fields for hosted units, scenarios and captures.

outputs.name: hostedEvidenceFields
outputs.description: A collection of validation schemas and builders: general strings up to 1,000,000 characters, nonempty names up to 300, lowercase 40-character commit hashes and 64-character content hashes, arrays up to 5,000 items, finite numbers, booleans and accepted mode/status values. Includes strict capture, scenario and unit objects with their contracts, ownership, runtime and budget details. These schemas check structure, not proof of execution.
